Hook to change upgrade costs/days. CORRECTION(V8996): Parses the listed names but also many more (ultimate_*, rush_*, development/research/dual percentages, max_simultaneous_*). The 100.0 default (0x42c80000) is only set for four struct slots at init, not for the cost fields.
